### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **24** documentable anchor(s).

**24** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f91ab5a08af7a7c4e5d3f6f89dd22fef67193ba0`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `objectName (symbol, 55 pages)`
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **20** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f91ab5a08af7a7c4e5d3f6f89dd22fef67193ba0` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3045c8370f55c5795a9492278a2d2cc91b84903b` — the merge of head `e5e62b28c322e16c662339fc3d6931a79a26647a` into base `f91ab5a08af7a7c4e5d3f6f89dd22fef67193ba0`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3045c8370f55c5795a9492278a2d2cc91b84903b && git checkout 3045c8370f55c5795a9492278a2d2cc91b84903b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f91ab5a08af7a7c4e5d3f6f89dd22fef67193ba0 e5e62b28c322e16c662339fc3d6931a79a26647a && git checkout -B drift-repro f91ab5a08af7a7c4e5d3f6f89dd22fef67193ba0 && git merge --no-ff e5e62b28c322e16c662339fc3d6931a79a26647a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f91ab5a08af7a7c4e5d3f6f89dd22fef67193ba0
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f91ab5a08af7a7c4e5d3f6f89dd22fef67193ba0` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e5e62b28c322e16c662339fc3d6931a79a26647a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`mergeValidationsByName`, `tenantRuleSettingsOf`, `withTenantRuleSettings`, `changedPackagedRuleKeys` + `VALIDATION_RULE_DEFAULTS`, `ValidationRuleCopyRefusedError` / `tenantRuleCopyRefusal`, `withPackagedOwnerRules`, `packagedRules`, `reportChangedRuleCopies`, `subtractExtenderContributions` no longer subtracting `validations`, `getPackagedObjectBase` merged by name), the new registry-validation-rule-by-name.test.ts (14), one expectation in engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts, the dated ADR-0029 D9.2a note, the changeset (`@objectstack/objectql` patch, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 not-required). 5 files, +705/−54. Fixes #27949 (ruling C′ 6524229156 + ruling B 6545641964; claim 6545757428 on seat 4's `2a499b92`; dev report 6546544933). Tier H by path (`docs/adr/**`).
Inputs: card #27949 body + both rulings + claim + dev report, the PR body, the PR diff at this head (every registry hunk read), `git grep` on `origin/main` at the merge-base (the concatenation at registry.ts L568, the `validations` subtraction at L4960, `getPackagedObjectBase`'s append at L5168, ADR-0029 D9.2a), check-runs (read 2026-10-31T17:20Z: all 49 latest-per-name check-runs completed, 34 success + 15 skipped, none failed, none running) — 49 checks. Nothing built or run here; the seat's numbers (objectql 507 files / 9847, 12 ablations all red, 70 derived gates, dogfood on the card) are the dev report's.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The fold's new rule is the ruled one.** On main `mergeObjectDefinitions` concatenated `validations` (L568) and `subtractExtenderContributions` removed only byte-equal extender rows, so a tenant overlay's reworded copy ran beside the extension's original. At head a rule's identity is its `name`: `mergeValidationsByName` drops every base rule of a name the later layer carries and appends the later layer's rules; different names stay additive (D9.2a's protection); between code layers the later same-named rule replaces, as a field does. `getPackagedObjectBase` serves the packaged set through the same merge, and `validations` leaves the subtraction list (`['indexes']` only), so a folded base re-folds to itself (#8027 pin).
- **What the tenant owns — `message` and `active`, nothing else (C′).** `tenantRuleSettings` is read only when the fold's base is a tenant overlay or runtime-authored owner (`tenantRuleSettingsOf`, first copy wins); `withPackagedOwnerRules` replaces a copy of the owner's rule with the owner's rule plus those two keys, and `mergeValidationsByName` applies the same settings to an extension's rule. The copy's `type`, condition and every other key never enter the enforced rule — the A05/A06 ablations pin it.
- **Load path reports, never refuses (B).** `reportChangedRuleCopies` compares each copy with `packagedRules` (owner + extensions merged by name) through `changedPackagedRuleKeys`, which fills schema defaults (`events`, `priority`, `severity`) before comparing so a parse-stamped copy is not a change, ignores `message`/`active`/`_`-stamps, and reports once per registry per (object, rule, copy, packaged) at `error` with the prescription. Nothing throws; a package upgrade cannot fail a boot on stored data. `registerObject` adds no build-time refusal — as B orders.
- **The save-door predicate exists, uncalled.** `tenantRuleCopyRefusal(name, body)` returns `ValidationRuleCopyRefusedError` (`INVALID_METADATA`, 422, `objectName`, `ruleName`, `changedKeys` with `type` first) or `null`; wiring it into the metadata save door is #28448 behind the `protocol.ts` serial queue. The predicate is stricter than "condition or type" (any package-owned key), which is C′'s "everything else is the package's" — stated in the PR.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — a copy's own condition no longer runs; `Metadata-protocol: none` — nothing an author can write changes at load (ruling B's own line); `patch` with a BREAKING banner under ruling A's grading. ADR-0087 not-required holds: no key moves and no stored row needs rewriting. The one changed expectation in engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts (served and refused once, with the tenant's sentence) is the behaviour the card filed for.
- **ADR note** records both rulings in D9.2a's own terms (different names add; same name merges by name with the package's condition; refusal at the save door; load only reports; idempotence by the merge). Governed path → Tier H approval owed after this record.

### ② Rulings cited

- 6524229156 (director#1, Tesla 「同意」 2026-10-30T13:40Z): **C′** — merge by name, message/active to the tenant, condition to the package. 6545641964 (director#2, Tesla 「同意」 2026-10-31T15:47Z): **B** — the loud refusal sits at the save door; load reports and runs the package's rule. Both implemented as ruled; no open ruling.

### ③ Narrowing / widening

- Narrowing at load for exactly one shape: a tenant overlay copy of a packaged or extension rule that changed more than `message`/`active` — its own condition no longer runs; the package's does, named once at `error`. Declared, corpus-safe (the fold reads stored rows as they are). Everything else is unchanged or now runs once instead of twice.

### ④ Behaviour / flags

- Tier H: `docs/adr/0029-…` — os-zhuang (or hotlong) approval owed before landing; the seat requests it after this record.
- Follow-up #28448 (save door) is `Blocked-by:` this PR; until it lands a changed copy is accepted at save and only reported at load — the ruled interim.
- Operators see `[Registry] [validation_rule_copy_changed]` once per changed copy per boot; the message names the keys and the prescription, never the condition's text beyond the key names.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同一对象里的校验规则改为按 `name` 合并。租户对套件规则的同名副本只保留它的提示文字（message）和开关（active），条件仍由套件决定；副本改了条件的，加载时只记一条 error 日志，并运行套件的规则，不会让启动失败。
- 为什么改：你 10-30 的裁定 C′（按名合并，message/active 归租户，条件归套件）和 15:47 对清单第 2 批的「同意」（裁定 B：保存时拒绝，加载时只报告）。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄一种情况，就是租户副本改了 message/active 以外的内容，这时它自己的条件不再运行；其余情况不变，或由原来重复运行两次变为只运行一次。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `mergeValidationsByName` 和 `reportChangedRuleCopies`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-validation-rule-by-name.test.ts`，14 项全部通过。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改了 ADR-0029 的 D9.2a 注记，属于 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang（或 hotlong）批准后才能合并。席位转为 ready 时会请求审阅。

席位意见：契约复审 PASS，两项裁定都已按原文实现。保存时的拒绝放在 #28448，它被本 PR 阻塞，要排在 `protocol.ts` 串行队列里。可以批准。
